fun plan(): Verdict {
    val engineReport = readFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/engine-report.json")
    val cedar = readFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/cedar.json")
    val guardiansPlan = readFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/guardians.json")
    val guardiansTranscript = readFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/guardians-transcript.json")
    val pr = readFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/pr.json")
    val taskContext = readFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/task-context.json")
    val verdict = computeVerdict(engineReport, guardiansPlan, guardiansTranscript)
    val evidence = makeEvidence(scope = emptyMap(), cedar = cedar, guardians = guardiansPlan, engineReport = engineReport, verdict = verdict, examined = listOf("policy/cedar/default", "policy/guardians/default.policy.yaml"))
    writeFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json", value = evidence)
    val completion = noop(message = "Security gather evidence written with PASS verdict; no GitHub action required beyond completion signal.")
    return verdict
}
